comments.author: Sophia
comments.body: u share information to craftsman every day for up to 3 times, the trade goods u share to them will give u respective contribution points for different production skills. accumulate those points by sharing information daily.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: With the introduction of Unions, it's now possible to gain Florentine points via almost every production skill (except for Alchemy, Linguistics, and Shipbuilding). Basically, join the right union for the skill you're using, then spam high level recipes. You can earn up to 999 points in that category per week (IIRC). That, coupled with the Oxford skill that returns Florentine points used in production, can make a lot of these recipes easier to produce.
